segment_summary.zh: F35–F38 中，机器人从白色衣柜一侧的走廊入口向前推进，前方走廊可见；随后 F40–F44 视角转向并靠近一处白色衣柜与墙角，左侧出现玻璃门/门洞，直行走廊不再在画面中，也未到达大房间、餐桌或深色门。
segment_summary.en: In frames F35–F38, the robot advanced from the hallway entrance beside a white wardrobe, with the corridor visible ahead. Then in frames F40–F44, the view turned toward and approached a white wardrobe and wall corner, with a glass doorway/opening appearing on the left; the straight hallway is no longer visible, and the large room, dining table, and dark door were not reached.

reason.zh: 任务要求经过左侧白色衣柜后进入走廊并沿走廊直行，经过两侧门洞，直到尽头大房间。F35–F38 虽有朝走廊前进的证据，但 F38 之后 F40–F44 连续近距面对白色衣柜和墙角，未保持走廊直行，画面中也没有餐桌椅或深色门，这与沿走廊直行的要求冲突。
reason.en: The task requires entering the hallway after passing the white wardrobe on the left, walking straight down the hallway past open doorways on both sides, and reaching the large room at the end. Although F35–F38 support advancing toward the hallway, F40–F44 continuously show the robot close to a white wardrobe and wall corner rather than continuing straight along the hallway, and no dining table with chairs or dark door is visible; this conflicts with the requirement to walk straight down the hallway.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: passing a white wardrobe on your left, then enter the hallway ahead
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 经过你左侧的白色衣柜，然后进入前方的走廊

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Walk straight down the hallway, passing open doorways on both sides.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Enter the large room at the end of the hallway.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 进入走廊尽头的大房间。

description.en: In frames F40–F44, the straight hallway is no longer visible; the view is close to a white wardrobe and wall corner, with a glass doorway/opening appearing on the left in F41–F44. No dining table with chairs or dark door is visible.
